# Tracebench

> Agent Ops Workbench — HITL control room for AI agents (Dominik Pawlikowski).

Portfolio Demo Mode (default): AGENT_TRANSPORT=fixture, JEV_ADAPTER=mock, EVAL_SCORER=mock-jev, OPS_TELEMETRY=fixture — ZERO API keys. No multi-tenant/auth.

UI: Phosphor Instrument (near-black + #B8FF3D, Geist, hairlines, radius 2–6).
Marketing: / + /story boutique rebuild; Control Plane Assembly (CSS 3D + optional Canvas lattice, no Three.js).

Architecture: hexagonal lite, event-sourced domain, AgentTransport (fixture|cloudflare), JevAdapter, OpsTelemetry. UI observes; LLM agent loops in apps/agent-worker are not implemented yet (DO persist/HITL/SSE scaffold only).

## Surfaces

- / — Marketing landing + Demo Mode CTA
- /story — Boutique scroll narrative
- /runs — Seeded runs (incl. run_live_approve, run_pipeline_ops)
- /runs/[id] — Timeline, HITL, audit, logs (A2A), Ops Trace panel
- /runs/[id]/graph — Read-only xyflow observe graph (useChildRuns)
- /evals — mock-jev release gate
- /dashboards — Ops boards (localStorage layout; useRunsDetails)
- /ops — Ops Trace fleet (fixture GenAI-shaped spans)
- /policy — Jev risk matrix
- /help — Hub + demo-mode + failure-gallery
- /help/faq — FAQ screenshots
- /architecture — Diagram + invariants
- /api/health — Readiness; demoMode.kind=demo|hybrid|live; 503 on critical fail

## Public

- GitHub: https://github.com/dpawlikowski/tracebench (code on main)
- Storybook Pages only: https://dpawlikowski.github.io/tracebench/
- Full app: local pnpm dev or Vercel (Stage E — still pending)
